BUYING & PROJECT PLANNING

BBQ Drinkware Planning: Personal Cups and Shared Service Tools

Plan cups by guest use and service accessories by station, then bring both lists into one project brief.

Prepare a Project Enquiry →

Separate two purchasing roles

Guest cups, sleeves and drink identifiers can be assigned individually. Pitchers, trays, ice buckets and opening tools usually belong to a shared service setup; do not automatically order one per guest.

Match the menu and setting

State the drinks, portion, serving surface, carrying requirements and cleanup plan. Outdoor use does not itself prove heat, impact or weather resistance.

Approve decoration and packing together

List each model and design quantity. Review whether bulk packing, individual packing or a specified kit matches the distribution plan; none is assumed included.

Before Sending the Enquiry

Review itemWhat to send
Model & portionSKU, vessel shape and required capacity option.
Use & configurationBeverage, temperature conditions, lid, straw or other components.
Artwork & deliveryDesign quantities, decoration position, packing, destination and arrival date.
